name: agentwalletapi
description: Managed EVM and Solana wallets for AI agents: balances, transfers, swaps, approvals, governance policy checks, cross-chain bridges, Escrow (formerly Get Paid) checkout, Polymarket, and YieldWolf Casino. Backed by the OpenClawCash agent API.

interface.shortDescription: Managed EVM and Solana wallets for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Adds OpenClawCash-managed wallets to Codex: balances, transfers, swaps, approvals, governance policy checks, cross-chain bridges, Escrow (formerly Get Paid) checkout, Polymarket, and YieldWolf Casino. A thin bridge to the existing OpenClawCash agent API over MCP; wallet keys and policy enforcement stay server-side, not in this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use my OpenClawCash wallet here in Codex. Ask my write-approval mode before the first write action, then follow it.
